name: Howe and Lawrence metal milling machine
description: Frederick Webster Howe and Richard S. Lawrence developed a milling machine while working at Robbins and Lawrence in Windsor.

impact.note: A better design of an existing machine tool, used by machinists in armouries and factories, with a few later millers descending from it.

date.basis: Date describes the reported event or archaeological context, not the origin of the general technique.
